says: Hello, little chefs! It is Mango. Today we make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich!
picture: Mango stands behind the light wooden kitchen counter, seen from the belly up, with the whole teal apron and its round yellow pocket clearly visible. One paw is raised beside the head in a friendly wave. On the light wooden counter, left to right: a small round wooden board, an open glass jar of light brown peanut butter with no label, one round white plate in the centre directly in front of Mango, an open glass jar of purple grape jelly with no label. On the wooden board lies a neat stack of two square slices of soft white bread with tan crusts. The plate is empty. In front of the jelly jar lies a small rounded wooden spreader with a blunt round tip (not a knife).
does: Mango waves the raised paw twice on 'Hello', lowers it, then points with one paw down at the stack of bread on 'sandwich'. The mouth opens and closes with every word. After the last word Mango closes the mouth and smiles.

says: First, put two slices of bread on your plate.
picture: Mango stands behind the light wooden kitchen counter, seen from the belly up, with the whole teal apron and its round yellow pocket clearly visible. On the light wooden counter, left to right: a small round wooden board, an open glass jar of light brown peanut butter with no label, one round white plate in the centre directly in front of Mango, an open glass jar of purple grape jelly with no label. One square slice of soft white bread already lies flat on the left half of the plate. Mango holds the second slice of bread in both paws, lifted just above the wooden board. The wooden board is otherwise empty. In front of the jelly jar lies a small rounded wooden spreader with a blunt round tip (not a knife).
does: Mango carries the slice of bread in both paws from above the wooden board sideways to the plate and lays it down flat on the right half of the plate, beside the first slice, on 'on your plate'. Then both paws let go. The slice is seen travelling the whole way from the board to the plate. Nothing appears from nowhere and nothing disappears. The mouth opens and closes with every word. After the last word Mango closes the mouth and smiles.

says: Spread peanut butter on one slice. Smooth, smooth, smooth.
picture: Mango stands behind the light wooden kitchen counter, seen from the belly up, with the whole teal apron and its round yellow pocket clearly visible. On the light wooden counter, left to right: a small round wooden board, an open glass jar of light brown peanut butter with no label, one round white plate in the centre directly in front of Mango, an open glass jar of purple grape jelly with no label. Two plain square slices of white bread lie flat side by side on the plate. The wooden board is empty. Mango holds a small rounded wooden spreader with a blunt round tip (not a knife) in one paw; its tip is dipped in the peanut butter jar and has a thick blob of light brown peanut butter on it. The other paw rests on the counter.
does: The paw lifts the spreader with its blob of light brown peanut butter out of the peanut butter jar, carries it to the bread slice nearest that jar, and wipes it back and forth across the slice on each 'smooth' until the whole top of that slice is covered in light brown peanut butter. The other slice stays plain white. The peanut butter is seen travelling from the jar to the bread. Nothing appears from nowhere. The mouth opens and closes with every word. After the last word Mango closes the mouth and smiles.

says: Spread jelly on the other slice. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle.
picture: Mango stands behind the light wooden kitchen counter, seen from the belly up, with the whole teal apron and its round yellow pocket clearly visible. On the light wooden counter, left to right: a small round wooden board, an open glass jar of light brown peanut butter with no label, one round white plate in the centre directly in front of Mango, an open glass jar of purple grape jelly with no label. Two square slices of bread lie flat side by side on the plate: the left slice is fully covered in light brown peanut butter, the right slice is plain white. The wooden board is empty. Mango holds a small rounded wooden spreader with a blunt round tip (not a knife) in one paw; its tip is dipped in the purple jelly jar and has a shiny blob of purple jelly on it. The other paw rests on the counter.
does: The paw lifts the spreader with its blob of purple jelly out of the jelly jar, carries it to the plain white slice nearest that jar, and wipes it back and forth across the slice on each 'wiggle' until the whole top of that slice is covered in shiny purple jelly. The peanut butter slice stays as it is. The jelly is seen travelling from the jar to the bread. Nothing appears from nowhere. The mouth opens and closes with every word. After the last word Mango closes the mouth and smiles.

says: Now press the two slices together. Pat, pat, pat.
picture: Mango stands behind the light wooden kitchen counter, seen from the belly up, with the whole teal apron and its round yellow pocket clearly visible. On the light wooden counter, left to right: a small round wooden board, an open glass jar of light brown peanut butter with no label, one round white plate in the centre directly in front of Mango, an open glass jar of purple grape jelly with no label. The slice covered in light brown peanut butter lies flat in the middle of the plate. Mango holds the other slice, covered in purple jelly, in both paws, lifted a little above the peanut butter slice and tilted so its purple jelly side faces down toward it. The wooden board is empty. The spreader lies on the counter in front of the jelly jar.
does: Mango lowers the jelly slice in both paws, jelly side down, onto the peanut butter slice so the two slices line up as one sandwich, then pats down gently on top with both paws on each 'pat'. Then Mango lifts both paws away and one closed sandwich sits on the plate, with a thin line of brown and purple showing between the two slices. Exactly two slices of bread, no more. The mouth opens and closes with every word. After the last word Mango closes the mouth and smiles.

says: Look, a peanut butter and jelly sandwich! Always cook with a grown-up. Bye-bye, little chefs!
picture: Mango stands behind the light wooden kitchen counter, seen from the belly up, with the whole teal apron and its round yellow pocket clearly visible. On the light wooden counter, left to right: a small round wooden board, an open glass jar of light brown peanut butter with no label, one round white plate in the centre directly in front of Mango, an open glass jar of purple grape jelly with no label. On the plate sits one closed sandwich made of two square slices of white bread with a thin line of brown peanut butter and purple jelly showing between them. The wooden board is empty. The spreader lies on the counter in front of the jelly jar. Mango points down at the sandwich with one paw; the other paw rests on the counter.
does: Mango taps the paw twice toward the sandwich on 'Look', nods once on 'grown-up', then raises the same paw beside the head and waves on 'Bye-bye'. The plate with the one sandwich stays still on the counter the whole time. The teal apron with its yellow pocket stays exactly as in the first frame, with no buttons. The mouth opens and closes with every word. After the last word Mango closes the mouth and smiles.
